brief.content: You write short public notices. Use only the facts given. Plain text, no markdown, no em dashes.

Write a notice of about 120 words in European Portuguese, as written in Portugal for people in Porto.
Facts: IPMA, the Portuguese weather institute, has an orange warning for persistent, sometimes heavy rain for the district of Porto from 06:00 to 18:00 on Saturday 21 November 2026 (Lisbon time), as read from PrompTugal's data at 18:15 UTC on 20 November 2026.
In the notice: say that it is raining now; advise taking the bus or the train rather than the car; advise charging their mobile phone; advise keeping the civil protection's phone contacts at hand; say that users can register on the civil protection's website to receive alerts; say that the emergency teams are working. End by saying to follow IPMA and the civil protection authority (ANEPC).

brief_br_differs_only_in.pt: European Portuguese, as written in Portugal
brief_br_differs_only_in.br: Brazilian Portuguese, as written in Brazil

note: Recorded real runs. The texts are model output; the scan and the figure check are code (variant.js, figcheck.js).

**Alerta de chuva persistente em Porto**

Atualmente está a chover em Porto. De acordo com o IPMA, há um aviso de chuva persistente, às vezes intensa, na área do Porto entre as 06:00 e as 18:00 de sábado, 21 de novembro de 2026 (horário de Lisboa).

Recomenda-se evitar conduzir e optar por transportes públicos, como o autocarro ou o comboio. Guarde o seu telemóvel carregado e mantenha os contactos da Proteção Civil à mão. Podes inscrever-te na plataforma da Proteção Civil para receber alertas em tempo real. As equipas de emergência estão ativas.

Segui as atualizações do IPMA e da Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil (ANEPC).
